Поляниця Надвірянського району Івано-Франківської області is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Поляницька сільська рада . Уточнений повний перелік назв вулиць, участків с. Поляниця ( поштові адреси ). Coverage: Поляницька сільська рада . The publisher named on the listing is Поляницька сільська рада . Its keywords include адреси, вулиця, перелік, список, участок. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2023-11-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
